input: Find one-week specialty camps (science, history, nature, arts) run by nonprofits for kids and teens in Henderson, Transylvania, Polk, Haywood and Jackson counties, NC (Hendersonville, Brevard, Tryon, Waynesville, Sylva). Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026: seven week-long STEAM camps for rising grades 1–3, with space and environmental themes.

candidates.name: Flat Rock Playhouse
candidates.note: 2026: week-long acting and musical-theatre camps for rising K–12, including teen conservatory training.

candidates.name: Pisgah Astronomical Research Institute
candidates.note: 2026: one- and two-week residential astronomy, space-science and STEM camps for middle and high school students.

candidates.name: Transylvania Community Arts Council
candidates.note: 2026: four week-long Summer Arts Academy sessions for ages 6–17; pottery, drawing, dance, photography and game design.

candidates.name: Tryon Fine Arts Center
candidates.note: 2026: week-long SASY visual/performing arts, PacJAM music and theater camps; SASY includes half-days for ages 5–7.

candidates.name: Tryon Arts & Crafts School
candidates.note: 2026: Summer Sizzler week-long youth art camps scheduled June 29–July 31.

candidates.name: Foothills Equestrian Nature Center (FENCE)
candidates.note: 2026: week-long nature/art and environmental camps for ages 5–12; also horse camps and other full- and half-day weeks.

candidates.name: Tryon Little Theater
candidates.note: 2026: co-presented the July 27–31 week-long theater production camp at Tryon Fine Arts Center.

candidates.name: Haywood Arts Regional Theatre (HART)
candidates.note: 2026: one-week Annie KIDS production camp; also a two-week musical-theatre intensive for middle and high school students.
